labels.label: bzprop:c3s3p9_hemisphere_dual
labels.notes: benzecri1960_ch3.tex:801-806 against prop9 (DualiteInterieur.lean:197): A ∈ CS (Déf. 8, the ∪ reading ruled by DEC-120), M arbitrary, so H = D({M}) is covered as the paper defines it; 1° A ⊆ interior (D {M}) and 2° M ∈ interior (D A), with Mathlib's interior in the quotient topology of S(n). The pairing is dotPairing n, i.e. the printed ⟨M,N⟩ = Σ m_i n_i (l.751-755), with D' = D (D'_dotPairing), so OQ-160's « mis en dualité » reading does not enter. prop9_of_isClosed drops convexity, a strengthening. Finding (printed proof via geodesic balls not followed; [sic] D(B) ⊂ A read D(B) ⊂ D(A)) is accurate and not used.

labels.label: bzcor:c3s3p9c_corps_convexe_hemisphere
labels.notes: l.825-828 against corollaire_hemisphere_ouvert (l.205): IsCorpsConvexeS n A (Déf. 11, independent of OQ-24) gives ∃ H, IsOpenHemisphere H (Déf. 5 as printed: open, F(H) = l⁻¹(ℝ⁺)) ∧ H.Nonempty (DEC-114 reading, added as a conclusion: a strengthening) ∧ A ⊆ H. Wraps the strict IsCorpsConvexeS.exists_forall_pos (Chapter2/Hilbert.lean:724), as the planner's evidence directs. corollaire_hemisphere_prop9 gives the Prop. 8 + Prop. 9 route with IsOpenHemisphere (int D({M})) proved. No proof printed; the REPORT says so.

labels.label: bzprop:c3s3p10_interieur_dual
labels.notes: l.831-835 against prop10 (l.248): A, B ∈ CS, A ⊆ interior B ↔ D B ⊆ interior (D A), both directions (« et réciproquement »). Converse via dotPairing_prop1 (D ∘ D = id on C(S(n))), the paper's own argument. prop10_forward (A closed, B any) is a strengthening. Proof findings checked: the display int D(A) = ⋂_{M∈A} int D({M}) is an interior/infinite-intersection interchange, ⊆ always, ⊇ needing compactness of A (here the tube lemma in mem_interior_D_iff); and the last step must read D(B) ⊂ int D({M}) (which Prop. 9 applied to D(B), with D(D(B)) = B, does give) — the [sic?] at l.848, OQ-160 (a). Both accurate; the statement is unaffected, and OQ-160 bears only on the printed proof, so the mark is honest under every live reading.
